description: Land Title Settlement Department - Ballapana Udabage, Galigamuwa D/S Division, Kegalle District - Cad. Map No. 610008
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including parcel numbers, owner names, land extents, and property details. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" including "land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) classification. There is no government personnel or structural content that would trigger Types 1-3, and the specialized nature of land registration clearly places it in Type 4 rather than the miscellaneous category.
